name: Ca Mau
provinceNote: Since 1 July 2025, Cà Mau is the former Cà Mau and Bạc Liêu provinces together. Resolution 202/2025/QH15, clause 22, passed on 12 June 2025, sets 7,942.39 km² and 2,606,672 people and borders An Giang, Cần Thơ, and the East Sea. The clause does not name a capital.
dotReason: The southern cape, the marker and the two seas, is worth the road from Cần Thơ.
summary: A Mekong Delta city at Vietnam’s southern tip, the base for the mangrove cape where two seas meet. Stand at the marker on the southern tip, travel through the mangroves at Nam Can, walk the granite rocks of Hon Da Bac, and eat mangrove crab. Suits travellers who want to reach the far end of the Mekong Delta.
timeNeeded: One night in the city, a road day south
fee: No single city ticket. Cape gate: 15,000–30,000 VND and 07:00–18:00, time at one point not limited; or 06:30–17:30 every day including Tết, adult 30,000 VND, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m and students 15,000 VND, no ticket under 1 m or for a severe disability. Electric cart 10,000–15,000 VND a person. Canoe about 600,000–800,000 VND for a short ride or about 1,200,000–1,600,000 VND for a long ride, for a boat of 6–8. Hòn Đá Bạc: no official fee, or 20,000 VND adult and 10,000 VND child, and 07:00–19:00. About 6.43 hectares, three rocks, the highest about 50 m. U Minh Hạ: no homepage fee or hour, or 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00, or about 30,000–50,000 VND, or 07:20–17:00. Boats 150,000 VND a person an hour or 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. Check on arrival.
getThere: Ca Mau airport (CAH): phường 6, about 10 km and 20–30 minutes, xe ôm 60,000 VND and taxi 150,000 VND; or số 93 đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, and 2 km, taxi 5–10 minutes at 70,000–100,000 VND, xe ôm 5–10 minutes at 20,000–40,000 VND. Expressway from Cần Thơ: 110.85 km, or nearly 111 km of main line plus nearly 26 km of links. Ride times: 1.5 hours, about 90 minutes, and more than 1 hour 15 minutes, from 3 hours before. Cape: 58.7 km from cầu Ông Tình at Năm Căn; more than 100 km from the city; 100–110 km and 2.5–3.5 hours; more than 50 km and more than 1 hour on Quốc lộ 1 to Năm Căn, plus more than 50 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road. Hòn Đá Bạc is about 50 km by water and 42 km by road, and about 50 km. Đầm Thị Tường is about 40 km. U Minh Hạ is about 40 km and about 1 hour, or about 35 km and about 50 minutes to 1 hour. Toll, a public coach fare, a city taxi that is not an airport ride, a canoe fare from Năm Căn, and a road-closure month: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca Mau travel guide — Cape Ca Mau, the southernmost point
seoDescription: Stand at Mũi Cà Mau, where the East Sea and the West Sea meet, then the mangrove and U Minh. The city is the night. The cape road starts south of Năm Căn.
intro: You stand at Cape Ca Mau, the southernmost point, mangrove and mudflat in front of you where the East Sea meets the West Sea. The ship-shaped panel has been in place since the end of 2020, and the GPS0001 marker closes đường Hồ Chí Minh. U Minh Hạ is the other forest, melaleuca on peat north of the city, a different gate from this cape.

The panel, recorded on 23 August 2024, carries “Tổ quốc tôi như một con tàu / Mũi thuyền ta đó Mũi Cà Mau”, the sail text “Mũi Cà Mau”, and the coordinates 8°37'30" north and 104°43' east. Work on the road-end marker started on 15 February 2017, at an investment of about 70 billion đồng. The same ground names the sea wall and Cột cờ Hà Nội. Two tidal regimes meet here and new mudflats form. A wetland point is also 08°41'00"N 104°47'32"E. Neither reading is the city center. Sleep in the river wards, phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is the other bed, and only when the dawn inside the gate is the point. Stay when the cape is the trip. Go to Cần Thơ when that river city is the trip.

The mangrove behind the tip is Vườn quốc gia Mũi Cà Mau. Decision 142/2003/QĐ-TTg of 14 July 2003 upgraded it from the Đất Mũi nature reserve of Decision 194/CT on 9 August 1986. The area is over 41,800 hectares, and also 41,862 hectares, about 13,400 hectares of mangrove and about 26,000 hectares of mudflat. Designation dates are 13/12/12, site number 2088, 27 November 2012, 2013, and 12 December 2013. This park, U Minh Hạ, and the west-coast belt are cores of the 2009 biosphere reserve. U Minh Hạ is at ấp Vồ Dơi, xã Đá Bạc, and it is a different park from U Minh Thượng. The expressway ends at nút giao IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, and motorbikes are not allowed on it. The cape road is the one south of Năm Căn. A departure from the city after 13:00 can miss the gate. The preferred hours on one account are 08:00–10:00 and after 15:00.

Hòn Đá Bạc is the granite you can walk on the Gulf, on the road toward U Minh Hạ, then Nông trường Minh Hà, Cơi Năm, and ấp Đá Bạc B, then one bridge onto the rock. It is xóm Kinh Hòn, xã Khánh Bình Tây, huyện Trần Văn Thời, and also ấp Kênh Hòn, xã Đá Bạc. The national listing is Decision 2245/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 22 June 2009. Lăng Ông Nam Hải and a whale skeleton are on the rock. In town the morning is the river. A floating market of hundreds of boats sits on the Gành Hào, in the center. The Cần Thơ dawn is a different market. Chùa Monivongsa Bopharam is on đường Đinh Tiên Hoàng, phường 1, also phường An Xuyên. Chùa bà Thiên Hậu is at số 77 Ngô Quyền, phường 9, also phường An Xuyên. Quan Âm Cổ Tự, chùa Hưng Quang, and đền Tân Hưng are separate. The provincial museum is số 221 Ngô Quyền, phường 1, and also số 1AB Lý Văn Lâm, phường 1, the working office since a provincial decision of 11 August 2021. Public displays are few. Nhà thờ Giáo xứ Cà Mau is 68 Lê Lợi, phường 2, and also 200/20 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6. Eat crab or salted ba khía with rice. Meat crab is firm and sweet, and roe crab is full and rich.
gettingAround: Cảng hàng không Cà Mau, IATA CAH, is the airport. One account puts it in phường 6, about 10 km from the center and 20–30 minutes in, with xe ôm at 60,000 VND and taxi at 150,000 VND, to be agreed before the ride. Another puts số 93 đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, and 2 km to the center, taxi 5–10 minutes and 70,000–100,000 VND, xe ôm 5–10 minutes and 20,000–40,000 VND. Commercial flights are set to resume 29 November 2026 after more than a year stopped for an upgrade, Vietnam Airlines on an A321, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55, return 14:50–15:50, fare 924,000–964,000 VND including the ticketing fee. The direct flight is also listed as operating, about 1 hour 10 minutes, one flight a day, with fares from 955,181 VND and from 1,206,000 VND, and seats on dates that include 28 November 2026. VASCO is also listed once a day on an ATR-72 or ATR-42, outbound 11:25 for about 1 hour, return 12:45 for about 1 hour. The block times in play are 1 hour, 1 hour 10 minutes, and the 12:50 departure. Connections via Tân Sơn Nhất are Hanoi about 4 hours 40 minutes to 7 hours 40 minutes, four flights a day, and Thanh Hóa about 4 hours 45 minutes, one flight a day. A Hanoi nonstop is not a timetable. No ferry runs from this cape to Phú Quốc.

There is no passenger station to take. The Mekong Delta has had no railway since the Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho line stopped in 1958. A pre-feasibility line runs 175.2 km from ga An Bình to ga Cần Thơ, through Ho Chi Minh City, Tây Ninh, Đồng Tháp, Vĩnh Long, and Cần Thơ, with twelve main stations, a hoped start at the end of 2027, and phase 1 basically finished in 2035. Cà Mau is not a station on that scheme. A later Cần Thơ–Cà Mau line has no decided alignment or year. The expressway is 110.85 km, and also nearly 111 km of main line plus nearly 26 km of link roads. It opened for traffic at 11:00 on 19 January 2026. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section is 73.2 km. The Cần Thơ–Hậu Giang section had been open since 22 December 2025. Speed is 80 km/h maximum and 60 km/h minimum. Motorbikes, bicycles, and people on foot are not allowed. The ride is 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before, also about 90 minutes, and one driver that morning took more than 1 hour 15 minutes. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section was paused on 16 March 2026 for unfinished drains, slopes, and shoulders, and the full line was to reopen at 11:30 on 29 April 2026. The Cần Thơ end is at phường Cái Răng, off the Nam Sông Hậu / Quốc lộ 91B road, near Cảng Cái Cui. The Cà Mau end is IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, on đường Hành lang ven biển phía Nam, or đường Xuyên Á. The expressway does not reach Đất Mũi.

South of the city, đường Hồ Chí Minh runs 58.7 km from cầu Ông Tình at Năm Căn to Khu du lịch Đất Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, huyện Ngọc Hiển. That project starts at Năm Căn, not at the city. Phase 1 was finished in 2016. The alignment is cấp III đồng bằng, design speed 80 km/h, and the cross-section still matches cấp V, about 40 km/h, on a sealed coat. Four bridges, Rạch Tàu, Rạch Vàm, Xóm Mũi, and Rạch Bầu Nhỏ, are at a 60 km/h design. An upgrade to a real cấp III road was proposed at about 4,204.1 billion đồng, with a hoped finish in 2027 if approved, a hope stated in 2023. The cape is more than 100 km from the city, and mũi Bãi Bùng is 34 km southwest of thị trấn Năm Căn. The road is also 100–110 km and 2.5–3.5 hours, more than 50 km and more than 1 hour on Quốc lộ 1 to Năm Căn, plus more than 50 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road. Motorbikes can use this road. A canoe from Năm Căn is named. Bến xe Cà Mau is on đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, phone 02903 811 063, about 9.3 km and about 15 minutes from the center, with local buses to Năm Căn, Sông Đốc, Thới Bình, U Minh, Phước Long, and Ngã Năm, at 05:00–17:00 with a bus every 15 minutes. Confirm the bay when you arrive. Hòn Đá Bạc is about 50 km by water and 42 km by road, and about 50 km. Đầm Thị Tường is about 40 km.

stayAreas.name: River wards
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in the city, in phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. The usual night is here. A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is for a dawn inside the gate. One listing closes that gate at 18:00. Another closes it at 17:30. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: Lunch is mangrove crab, steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua. Ba khía muối is the small crab with hot rice. Meat crab is firm and sweet, and roe crab is full and rich. Ba khía eats fallen mắm fruit, so the meat is firm and the roe is scant. The food guide is the rest: mudskipper, the U Minh pot, grilled snakehead, Khai Long clams, bee-pupa salad, eel with nhàu leaves, and the bags to carry, among them Thới Bình mắm, Trần Hợi dried banana, and Cái Nước bồn bồn.
interestsBody: Dining is mangrove crab and ba khía muối with rice. The food guide holds the mudskipper, the U Minh pot, the clams, the bee-pupa salad, eel with nhàu, and the bags.
Rừng đước is the Ramsar mangrove at the tip. The area is over 41,800 hectares, and 41,862 hectares. Designation dates are 13/12/12, 27 November 2012, 2013, and 12 December 2013.
Hòn Đá Bạc is the granite on the Gulf. Khai Long is the clam flat, not a towered shore. Hòn Khoai sits offshore in the reserve.

Năm Căn is the fishing town on the way south. The city night is the river. U Minh Hạ is peat and melaleuca north of the city, a different gate from the cape. Dried shrimp, honey, and bánh phồng tôm are what you carry.

body: Meat crab is firm and sweet and roe crab is full and rich. Order it steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua. Ba khía eats fallen mắm fruit, so the meat is firm and the roe is scant. The salted form is the famous one, with hot rice. Hấp, rang me, and nướng are also named.
On 29 December 2019 the crabs were said to gather around the tenth lunar month. Muối ba khía and gác kèo ong were named national intangible heritage.

paragraphs: A floating market of hundreds of boats sits on the Gành Hào, in the center. Năm Căn’s market is the stop on the way south, not this dawn.
Carry tôm khô, mật ong, and bánh phồng tôm. Thới Bình mắm, Trần Hợi dried banana, and Cái Nước bồn bồn are the other bags.

faqs.q: Where should I sleep in Ca Mau?
faqs.a: In the city, in phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành. A night at ấp Mũi is for a dawn inside the gate. One listing closes that gate at 18:00, and another closes it at 17:30. No hotel brand is a pick.

faqs.q: Is a flight into Ca Mau running, and which clock is it?
faqs.a: The clocks disagree, so check the airline before you count on a seat. Commercial flights are set to resume 29 November 2026, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55 and the return 14:50–15:50, at 924,000–964,000 VND. The direct flight is also listed as operating, about 1 hour 10 minutes, once a day, with fares from 955,181 VND and from 1,206,000 VND. VASCO is listed at 11:25 outbound and 12:45 back, about 1 hour.

faqs.q: How long is the expressway from Can Tho?
faqs.a: 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before, also about 90 minutes, and one driver that morning took more than 1 hour 15 minutes. The length is 110.85 km, and nearly 111 km of main line plus nearly 26 km of links. The expressway ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ and does not reach Đất Mũi.

faqs.q: What does the Đất Mũi gate cost, and when does it shut?
faqs.a: 15,000–30,000 VND and 07:00–18:00, and also 06:30–17:30, adult 30,000 VND, and 15,000 VND for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m or a student. The hours disagree. Cart and canoe prices sit on the tour account: 10,000–15,000 VND a person, and about 600,000–800,000 VND or about 1,200,000–1,600,000 VND for a boat of 6–8.

faqs.q: Is there one entrance fee for Hòn Đá Bạc and for U Minh Hạ?
faqs.a: No. Hòn Đá Bạc has no official fee, and also 20,000 VND for an adult and 10,000 VND for a child, with 07:00–19:00. U Minh Hạ has no homepage fee or hour, and also 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00, about 30,000–50,000 VND, and 07:20–17:00.

season.label: Clams after Tết
season.note: Bãi Khai Long, nearly 4 km and about 230 hectares, is busiest for clams after Tết through the end of May and June. The gate is daytime: 07:00–18:00, and also 06:30–17:30. Nghinh Ông Sông Đốc moves. The 2025 peak was 11–17 March, equated to 12–18 of the second lunar month, opening the evening of 13 March, and also 14–16 of the second lunar month, 13–15 March 2025. In 2026 the 15th of the second lunar month fell on 2 April, the 101st time. Nghinh Ông Gành Hào and Hương rừng U Minh sat inside 25–30 April 2026, and Festival tôm in November 2026. The Lạc Long Quân rite at xã Đất Mũi has no civil dates on the cape board.
